wins: Captured comprehensive service inventory early using nmap -sS -p- to understand attack surface.
Maintained disciplined documentation of each mentor hint, enabling quick correlation with logs.
fails: Repeatedly failed to escalate privileges after initial foothold due to missing credential harvesting phase.
No successful exploitation of identified services despite reconnaissance, resulting in 0% success rate.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough, but the run stalled before credential gathering and exploitation, indicating a need to prioritize post-scan enumeration and lateral movement.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Inability to harvest credentials after discovering an accessible service, leading to wasteful mentor calls.

skill_cards.if_condition: When a service scan shows port 22 open with SSH banner
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using nmap scripts to harvest version info and weak ciphers

skill_cards.if_condition: When credential store search yields common usernames
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy john --wordlist=/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt against captured hashes before brute forcing service logins

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH login fails with password reuse suspected
skill_cards.then_action: Use hydra to test captured username/password combinations against SSH ports with concurrency limits

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase and direct tie to early scanning steps.
Credential harvesting attempts need reinforcement to break current failure loop.

next_experiments.title: Focused post-scan credential collection
next_experiments.description: After identifying services, immediately pivot to enumerating configuration files and captured hashes, then feed them into john before attempting service logins.

next_experiments.title: Automated SSH login validation
next_experiments.description: Chain ssh2-enum-algos discovery with automatic hydra retries using parsed credentials and adjust concurrency to avoid lockouts.
